anneal_trusted_mir_boundary.note: Data structures PtrVal (415-418), AllocByte (422-424), Allocation (578-583), CallerMemory (586-587), Val.ptr/bytes (552, 556) exist, but initState rejects !q.callerMem.allocations.isEmpty (803-804) and ref/rawPtr locals (721-724, 815-816); evalBinOp rejects .offset (1146); evalRvalue rejects .ref/.addressOf (1313); evalStatement rejects non-empty dst.projection (1407-1408) and StatementKind.unsupported incl. CopyNonOverlapping (1427).

rust_const_eval_interpret.note: Computes MulWithOverflow of right count * pointee_size, rejects unsigned wrap-around negative offset_bytes (347-351), and delegates to ptr_offset_inbounds.

CopyNonOverlapping (958-967) calls copy_intrinsic(..., nonoverlapping: true); copy_intrinsic computes size * count overflow (1096-1101), checks ptr alignment for both src and dst even when size==0 (1106-1107), and calls mem_copy (1109).

rust_const_eval_interpret.symbol: check_ptr_access, check_ptr_access_signed, check_and_deref_ptr, write_scalar, read_scalar, mem_copy_repeatedly
rust_const_eval_interpret.note: check_and_deref_ptr (519-566) returns None immediately if size == 0 (532-534) and throws DanglingIntPointer or PointerOutOfBounds otherwise. mem_copy_repeatedly (1484-1615) checks bounds/access hooks, snapshots provenance (1540) and init_mask (1542), rejects same-alloc overlapping ranges when nonoverlapping (1579-1587), and performs bytewise copy.

Checks init_mask.is_range_initialized (694-699), reads/writes target endian bytes via read_target_uint (703) / write_target_uint (756), and rejects non-pointer scalar reads over provenance when !Prov::OFFSET_IS_ADDR (719-724).
Precondition sets zero_size = count == 0 || size == 0 and calls ub_checks::maybe_is_aligned_and_not_null(..., zero_size).

zerocopy_first_customer.symbol: try_read_from, FromBytes::{read_from_bytes, read_from_prefix}, IntoBytes::{as_bytes, write_to, write_to_prefix, write_to_suffix}

a_zerocopy_mir_census.summary: Compiled zerocopy 0.8.64 (--cfg feature="alloc" --cfg feature="std") at opt-level=0 and opt-level=2. At Runtime(PostCleanup) (the exact capture point of trusted/rustc-capture), zerocopy has 0 direct BinOp::Offset and 0 direct CopyNonOverlapping intrinsic statements because those live inside core::slice::get_unchecked / core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping / core::ptr::offset until cross-crate MIR inlining runs. At opt-level=2 Runtime(Optimized), cross-crate inlining materializes 11 BinOp::Offset functions and 5 StatementKind::Intrinsic(CopyNonOverlapping) functions inside zerocopy itself.
